rooms.shape_reasoning: Widest room in the archetype (30 tiles) — 14-vertical-slice.md §10: 'wide, single-height, open floor'. The entry room establishes scale before any hazard is introduced.
Smaller footprint than Ground Relay (12x7) reached through a single door — §10: 'smaller, dense shelving rows'. Dead-ends back to Ground Relay per the branch rule (11-moment-to-moment.md §5).
Rectangular, wider than tall (20x10) — §10: 'rectangular, breaker panel along the back wall, 2-3 transformer housings as cover'. Reached by ladder straight down from Ground Relay.
Largest square-ish footprint on the critical path (24x10) — §10: 'cluttered, maze-like rack layout'; the Sound entity has no fixed patrol and needs room to roam toward noise.
Smallest room in the archetype (6x5 = 30 tiles^2) — §10: 'small, cramped closet'. A dead-end door branch off Equipment Floor, no entity.

Tallest and narrowest room by a wide margin (6x28 — height more than 4x width) — §10: 'narrow vertical shaft, winding ladder path'. Authored as a single straight ladder for this pass (T-0328 edge case: a winding path is acceptable to simplify on the first geometry pass).
Open deck (22x10), sized to give the chain-tear room to read as a centerpiece — §10: 'open deck, tear as a chroma-lit centerpiece'. Terminates the chain (16-level-design.md §5 — Tear role).
